en: A monochrome illustrated postcard depicting a busy street scene in an old European city as an electric tram arrives, causing chaos among pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and street vendors. A tall baroque church tower dominates the background. In the upper right is an inset with horses labeled as being out of service, and the foreground includes caricatured townspeople reacting dramatically to the new tram. Handwritten cursive text runs along the right edge, and printed captions and publisher details appear around the image.
